description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to process container management within the WPEFramework. It includes abstractions for network interfaces, memory and processor info, container iteration, and container control operations.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating network interfaces associated with a container, providing methods to get interface name, number of addresses, and specific IP address.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface representing memory usage statistics (allocated, resident, shared) for a container.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface representing CPU usage metrics for a container, including total usage, per-core usage, and number of cores.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing containers, providing access to container IDs.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Interface representing a container, with methods to retrieve its ID, PID, memory and CPU info, network interfaces, and control methods to start/stop the container.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all existing container IDs.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container instance by its ID, returning nullptr if not found.

ctags.name: IContainerIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/

ctags.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class INetworkInterfaceIterator : public Core::IIterator,  public Core::IReferenceCounted  {$/
